1.consolidated_definition: Yaguas que produce la palma real que denominan salada. Esta yagua no es flexible y sus tiras son como vidriosas y se parten al menor esfuerzo.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Fibers produced by the royal palm tree known as salada, characterized by stiff and brittle strands that break easily under minimal stress.
